event: Maternal deaths added to national surveillance
plain_language: Tanzania began including maternal deaths among notifiable events, though the data was little used.
The ten-year record starts; the hospital death rate is about 40 per 100,000 births.
The worst year of the decade: 269 maternal deaths and a rate of 69.64 per 100,000 births.
From 2013, hospital death report forms are entered into the national electronic system each month.
The record closes with the rate at about 58 per 100,000; facility births have risen to 63%.
